title: John Trump likely involved in the 1952 Washington wave

tellings.quote: I personally think he would have been involved in, for example, the 1952 wave over DC, which was a very radar-intensive wave.

plain: A man named John G. Trump was probably involved in the 1952 wave, a run of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C. that showed up heavily on radar. A researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala offers this as a personal guess, in an episode about UFOs and nuclear weapons, saying "I personally think he would have been involved" because it was "a very radar-intensive wave." If so, it would tie a known figure to the government's handling of those sightings.
